WITH Accounts_BOB AS
(
SELECT [NO],SCD_START_DATE,SCD_END_DATE FROM eds.BOB_TBLACCOUNT
)
 
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
SELECT
DISTINCT CUST.CORE_CUST_ID,CUST.SCD_START_DATE,CUST.SCD_END_DATE
FROM eds.DEPOSIT_FACT DF
INNER JOIN Accounts_BOB BOB
    ON DF.FORACID = BOB.NO
	AND DF.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN BOB.SCD_START_DATE AND BOB.SCD_END_DATE
INNER JOIN eds.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP AAS
    ON DF.GAM_ACID = AAS.ACID
    AND DF.GAM_BANK_ID = AAS.BANK_ID
    AND DF.AS_OF_DATE = AAS.AS_OF_DATE
INNER JOIN eds.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    ON AAS.CUST_ID = CUST.CORE_CUST_ID
    AND AAS.BANK_ID = CUST.BANK_ID
    AND AAS.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE DF.AS_OF_DATE = '2024-06-28'
AND DF.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY,1) = 'C'
) A
